messages.author: be5831679f44e5dc
messages.subject: Error with gl.LDNe (but actually gl2genepop)
parts:
Hi All,

I've installed Ne Estimator on my Mac, and confirmed that it works with the included test dataset.

However, when I run gl.LDNe, I get this error:

Population     1 [Blackdown_364818_OMG_BRFDArT_]
Nondigit at locus 1, sample 2: [Blackdown_364820_OMG_BRFDArT_]
No population is run!
Error in str_split(res[res %like% "Lowest"], "\\s{3,}")[[1]] :
  subscript out of bounds

I tested this by running gl2genepop and trying to run it through Ne Estimator directly, it can read the right number of SNPs and the right number of populations, but says it's not in the right format, and again errors on the same individual.

Attached is the first pop section as output by gl2genpop (have 4 populations in reality). Any ideas on what is going wrong here with the format out of gl2genepop? I've checked that I don't have duplicate locus names.

Thanks,

Renee

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Error with gl.LDNe (but actually gl2genepop)
parts:
Hi Renee,

It seems that there is a maximum number of characters for individuals labels in the program NeEstimator, but I couldn't find any specifics about this. 
One solution is to change the individual names as below. 

library(dartRverse)
load("glunlinkedSNPs.Rdata")
# reducing individuals names to 10 characters and make them unique
indNames(gl.unlinked.snps) <- make.unique(substr(indNames(gl.unlinked.snps),1,10),sep = "_")
r1 <- gl.LDNe(gl.unlinked.snps)

Cheers,
Luis
